sections.title: Clothes, colours, and adjectives
body: Ask Kan jag prova den? for an en-item and Kan jag prova det? for an ett-item.
Useful size words are liten, stor, lång and kort. Liten → litet → små is irregular.
Most colour words agree like other adjectives.

examples.en: I am looking for a warm winter jacket.

examples.fi: Den här blå jackan är varm.

examples.en: Do you have a larger size?
Yes. Do you want to try it?

sections.title: Adjectives agree with nouns
body: With a singular en-word, use the base adjective: en röd tröja.
With a singular ett-word, many adjectives add -t: ett rött paraply.
With a plural noun, many adjectives add -a: röda tröjor.

examples.fi: en stor jacka / ett stort plagg

assignment.title: Episode 12 mission: Clothes, colours, and adjectives
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear twice and answer: Why not choose the blue sweater?

READ: Read for purpose and detail. Answer: What colour is the jacket?

SPEAK: Ask for a clothing item, colour, and size, then try it. Try once unaided, then improve one detail.

WRITE: Describe one en-word, one ett-word, and one plural. Check word order, forms, and purpose.

TRANSFER: Change en to ett and then plural.

RETURN: Complete en röd, ett rött, röda.
assignment.model:
Speaking: Jag söker en blå jacka i storlek M. Kan jag prova den?
Writing: En röd tröja. Ett rött paraply. Röda jackor.

takeaways: Use: Jag söker en varm jacka och ett varmt plagg.
